settings.description: The seed of the load test's invented words and chats. The same seed makes the same load.
How many years back the first person's chats reach in the full load test.
How many chats the first person has in the full load test.
The mean number of turns in a generated chat. A chat has from one turn to twice the mean less one.
About how many invented words one generated turn holds, the person's message and the reply together. A fifth are the person's.
How many turns the first person's one long chat has in the full load test.
How many more people the full load test makes, each with a smaller load, who all send at once.
How many chats each of the other people has in the full load test.
How many different invented words the load test writes with.
One generated chat in this many has an uploaded file. Zero makes none.
The mean size of a generated upload, in kilobytes. A file is from a tenth of the mean to about twice it.
One generated chat in this many has an artifact, in two versions. Zero makes none.
The mean size of one version of a generated artifact, in kilobytes.
How many times the full load test makes each measurement. The median and the 95th percentile are taken over them.
How many characters the fake provider streams as the reply of a measured turn, in pieces of fake.delta_size.
How many days back the chats of the small load test reach: few enough that some of its calls fall in Operations' last day.
How many chats the first person has in the small load test, the one verify runs.
The mean number of turns in a chat of the small load test.
How many turns the long chat has in the small load test: enough to outgrow the local model's window.
How many more people the small load test makes.
How many chats each of the other people has in the small load test.
How many times the small load test makes each measurement.
The share of each budget the small load test holds its median to, in percent.
The most time from a message sent in a long chat to its model call opening: reading the chat, packing the context and recording the call.
The most time from a message sent to its model call opening, in a chat with attached chats, an upload and a project.
The most time the model's search_chats tool may take across every chat a person has.
The most time the chat search route may take across every chat a person has.
The most time the first page of the chat list may take.
The most time opening the long chat may take.
The most time Keystone may add before the first streamed words, with one person sending and a model that answers at once.
The most time Keystone may add before the first streamed words, with every person sending at once.
The most time Keystone may take to pass on a reply of loadtest.reply_chars from a model that writes it at once, for one person.
The most time Keystone may take to pass on a reply of loadtest.reply_chars, with every person sending at once.
The most time this month's usage report may take.
The most time the Operations report may take.
The most time the home screen's read of the crossed limits may take.
